title: cyclosorus productus

It is native to various regions, including China, Japan, and the Americas, and is known for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The Narrow-leaved Cinnamon Fern has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Cyclosorus productus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential health benefits.
